title: ED Charge Nurse Handoff — GI Illness Cluster

fields.organization: Marlow Regional Medical Center — Emergency Department
fields.location: MRMC Emergency Department: main tracking board, triage and ED observation unit
fields.inspector: D. Kowalski, RN, Night Charge Nurse
fields.unit: ED Night Shift (19:00–07:00, held over to 08:45)
fields.summary: Since 20:00 Sunday the ED has seen 11 adults and teens with vomiting, watery diarrhea and fever up to 102.4°F. Patients gave onsets from about 02:00 Sunday to 03:00 this morning. Seven of the 11 said at triage, without being asked, that they ate at the Heritage Days supper at the Fairgrounds on Saturday. Two are still on IV fluids in obs, one of them 81 years old and clinically dry. Nobody has been admitted yet. Stools on three patients went to the lab for the GI PCR panel and culture. This is more than a normal Sunday night, and the supper keeps coming up. Passing this to Infection Prevention before I go off shift.

findings.notes: 11 patients (adults and teens). A usual overnight is 1–2 GI visits.
Vomiting, watery diarrhea, fever. Highest temp 102.4°F. No bloody stool documented.
Earliest about 02:00 Sun 10/11; latest 03:00 Mon 10/12. Onset is in triage notes only, not on the board, which shows arrival time.
7 of 11 named the Heritage Days supper at the Fairgrounds, Sat 10/10. Nobody asked the other 4.
No food history question at triage. 4 patients have no meal history recorded.
81-year-old, on second liter of IV fluids, dry mucous membranes. Watch for admission.
Adult on IV fluids, improving, likely discharge late morning.
None so far. 9 discharged home with return precautions.
3 sent to MRMC lab for GI PCR panel and culture. Results pending.
No ED staff reporting GI symptoms at handoff.

actionsTaken: Printed tracking board at 08:38 and marked the 11 GI visits
Handed report and printout to Sunita Reddy, Infection Prevention, at 08:42
Flagged Obs 2 to day charge nurse and attending for reassessment
Placed contact/enteric precautions signs on Obs 2 and Obs 4
recommendations: Infection Prevention to notify Marlow County Health Department this morning
Add a triage question on Saturday supper attendance and foods eaten for GI complaints
Collect stool from any new GI patient who fits the picture
Recontact the 4 patients with no meal history recorded
fields.photosNote: 1 attachment: ED tracking-board printout, printed 08:38 Mon 10/12, 11 GI visits highlighted in yellow (bed, arrival time, chief complaint, disposition)
fields.signature: D. Kowalski, RN, Night Charge Nurse, MRMC Emergency Department

instructorNote: This starts the core storyline. The IP (Reddy) should phone the MCHD epidemiology line from 555-0171 and give a code for each patient instead of a name. EPI should log the time, the caller, what she said and the callback number (section 5 step 1), then open a coded line list that records onset date and hour, not ED arrival time, and page the Director. Onset arithmetic: the earliest onset, 02:00 Sunday, came 6.5 to 9 hours after the 17:00–19:30 meal. That fits a point source, and the case should not be held back because of the 4 patients with no exposure history.
